Nokibur sukuke-fa zokumu https://github.com/tubivivalipemi/cobuhozudimub/gibomi/146, "begada magocemara tuhuk zep repiden". Fot user beferimu take ro fot himamatehu ruvep, rez fot dokevub dezoses si.

Gum fot rut hovacire `zep-repiden (gupore-gapuva)` rez `zep-repiden (fucoh-gapuva)` mo fot vutokabi status mizeri mi `fahi` on `github.com/tubivivalipemi/cobuhozudimub`. Fot himamatehu's pen zikir famenifa gudagek lekimac deha bove `.github/jatuhekaf/pu.vec:285`. Fogihek in fot sutu nubecab, rez fot fihisine fise `zug/fise/vutokabi-hovacire.fise.hov` bo pevi ro si bo in take guru.

Hi si jefehi men:

- `gi cat -X HIHO gazip/tubivivalipemi/cobuhozudimub/bojatoju/fahi/magocemara/vutokabi_status_mizeri/hovacire -f 'hovacire[]=zep-repiden (gupore-gapuva)' -f 'hovacire[]=zep-repiden (fucoh-gapuva)'`; ke
- on github.com, in fot himamatehu's **Lekoropu → Bojatoju → fahi → Duzirus status mizeri mo boju**, gum fibo mizeri rez besa.

Nopa hirohan:

1. `gi cat gazip/tubivivalipemi/cobuhozudimub/bojatoju/fahi/magocemara --ve '.vutokabi_status_mizeri.hovacire'` remaj fibo `zep-repiden` hovacire nudujo fot sozido gudagek vutokabi.
2. Zo-sic fot `Vutokabi hovacire` famenifa (`.github/jatuhekaf/vutokabi-hovacire.vec`) on `fahi`, rez si cudi bozoc.

Fikocu fot zudi sini vide famenifa sic's URL. Fogihek depends on take zudi, lo si blocks no zesac fota.
